variants.A: Current HEAD plus the two allowlisted assigned-room batching source files
variants.B: Unmodified current HEAD; hydration wrapper present in both builds

method.primary: AB/BA blocks only; A minus B; negative latency delta favors A (assigned-room-batch)
method.control: Middle AA pair reported separately, never pooled into AB inference
method.uncertainty: 10000 deterministic hierarchical paired bootstrap draws: resample four AB/BA pairs, then matched wave indices within each pair; retain all four participants in each sampled wave
method.interval: Percentile 2.5/97.5; descriptive and limited by four pairs on one shared host
method.exclusions: Only the predeclared one-wave warmup per condition per block is excluded from primary timing; all raw observations and failures retained. No load-based exclusions or outlier trimming.
method.limits: No production SLO or equivalence threshold is asserted; intervals cannot prove absence of a small regression.
